ready_rule: PR checks green, CI not failing, merges cleanly, not a draft, no reason to close, and at least 2 test reports from other people posted after its last commit (a #1607 batch that passed counts as one)
label_rule: the maintainer's labels (xcl-dev/xcl#1833) compared with what the board reads; a second look, never a verdict

label_why.off-goal-but-runtime: has off-goal, but changes runtime code (crates/*/src outside tests): the label's own rule is tests, scripts, CI or docs only
label_why.off-goal-but-goal-issue: has off-goal, but says it fixes, addresses or is part of a goal:world-load issue
label_why.off-goal-but-ai-goal: has off-goal, but the AI card says it bears on the goal (world-load wall or #1269)
label_why.goal-missing-issue: no goal:world-load, but says it fixes, addresses or is part of a goal:world-load issue
label_why.goal-missing-ai: no goal:world-load, but the AI card says it changes what stops runs today (#1269 or the world-load wall)
label_why.goal-but-ai-no-runtime: has goal:world-load, but the AI card says it changes no runtime code (tests, tools, docs)
label_why.duplicate-not-1607: has duplicate, but no group checked by two people in #1607 names it

reasons.duplicate-checked: two contributors checked it in xcl-dev/xcl#1607 and suggest keeping another PR with the same change
reasons.redoes-merged: the second AI check (it reads the diffs) says it makes the same change as a merged PR
reasons.duplicate-open: the second AI check says it makes the same change as another open PR, which looks more complete or is older
reasons.rules-stale: a required check fails or it conflicts with its base branch, and its last commit is over 7 days old (CONTRIBUTING: closed after a week)
reasons.rules-failing: the repo's own required check (PR checks) fails on its last commit, or it conflicts with its base branch (CONTRIBUTING: it waits until fixed)
reasons.ai-off-goal: AI reading, confirmed by a second model: a runtime change that does not touch what stops the title today, no run shows the bug, and the bug is only argued from the code (or it only moves code); tools, diagnostics, tests and docs are never listed

note: Candidates for a maintainer, not verdicts. The board closes nothing and writes nothing on GitHub.
